unit_03.eye-workshop.v2.explanation: Your eyebrows, eyelashes and eyelids help protect your eyes.

unit_03.sense-partners.v2.explanation: We see with our eyes and hear with our ears. We smell with our nose, taste with our tongue and feel with our skin.

unit_03.step.030.explanation: We can see, smell, touch and taste the watermelon.

unit_03.sense-lab.v2.explanation: We have five senses. Taste buds on our tongue help us taste. Holding our nose makes food harder to taste. Sweet, sour and salty are tastes.

unit_03.step.043.explanation: Taste and smell work together. Holding your nose makes the apple harder to taste.
